title: [DOC2-11] Relay guide key-loss text treats the relay DID as derived from the key
description: Review finding DOC2-11: Relay guide key-loss text treats the relay DID as derived from the key (lens DOC2). Location: guides/relay-operator.md:1478, :1491, :1509; compare :284-289, :1789. Fix: The guide's own default is `relay_did = "did:web:..."`, and :1789 explains that did:web keeps the DID across key changes. Limit "the relay DID is permanently lost", "There is no recovery path" and "The DID is derived from the public key" to `did:key` relays. For did:web, recovery means publishing a new key in `did.json` and the manifest. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
